text: なまえ　ラプラス　シー　ドラゴン　とも　よばれる　うみの　おうじゃ　です！

structure.jp: シー　ドラゴン　とも　よばれる
うみの　おうじゃ　です！
structure.en: it is the king of the seas!

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: よばれる is よぶ 'call' changed to say the thing is done to it by others. よばれる = 'is called'.

patterns.name: 〜とも
patterns.span: シー　ドラゴン　とも　よばれる
patterns.explanation: と gives the name something is called, and も adds 'also'. シー　ドラゴン　とも　よばれる = 'is also called the sea dragon'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: よばれる　うみの　おうじゃ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. シー　ドラゴン　とも　よばれる　うみの　おうじゃ = 'the king of the seas, who is also called the sea dragon'.
